title: A Debt for the Asset
author: Yara Whitlock
blurb: Ada Eastwick, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent fifteen years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trade the one secret worth killing for before the summit convenes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
